lines.en: I move while turning.

lines.zh: 我脚下的尘被卷成一个圈。
lines.en: The dust under me is drawn into a ring.
My edge turns without pause.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雾被吸进来。
lines.en: Mist is drawn in where I pass.
I sink a little from mid-air.
My core glows.
I close in, ring by ring.
I stop, then spin up again.
Stones circle around me.
I hang there, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 核心外面的东西一直在动。
lines.en: The shell around my core never stops.
I am drawing in the mist nearby.

lines.zh: 我的速度不快，可从不停。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never stop.
I am waiting for somewhere to land.
The pure light at my core is steady.
The ground here has split.
I have drawn in another ring.

lines.zh: 我在听灰里有没有脚步。
lines.en: I listen for steps in the ash.
My spin has changed slightly.
Gravel rises from the ground.
I am working out how far you are.
I tilt slightly.
The light at my core wavers.
The mist is thin here.
I wait for it to gather.
I turn, my core facing you.

lines.zh: 我的一条旋臂扫过你头顶。
lines.en: One of my spiral arms sweeps over your head.
I am measuring your weight.
My edge has touched the ground.
Look at the light in my core.
The core at my center pulses bright and dim.
I have gone three full circles around you.

lines.zh: 你身上有我要的东西吗。
lines.en: Do you carry what I need?
I lean toward you slowly.
My turning is not hurried.
I wobble and my spin falters.
A piece of my edge is gone.
I slowly find it again.
The light at my core dims.
I am trying to steady.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我中心边上。
lines.en: That struck near my core.
I shifted back half a foot.
My ring has loosened.
I draw the ring tight again.
I will not scatter so easily.

lines.zh: 两百点血，转起来就成漩涡。
lines.en: Two hundred health, and I spin into a vortex.
I do not live by eating.
I spin once and ignore it.
That would be drawn into me.
That cannot pull me in.
You keep this one yourself.
That will not buy a core.
I tilted my edge aside.
I do not take that in.
I keep turning here, waiting.
My edge pushes you off.
A spinning thing is hard to shove.
That got drawn in a little.
I have found my spin again.
Stones are thrown off me.

lines.zh: 转起来的东西停不下来。
lines.en: A spinning thing does not stop.

lines.zh: 别靠得这么近，会被卷进去。
lines.en: Do not come that close; you will be drawn in.
My spin quickened.
I have not left this ground.
I was spun into being.
Turning is all I do.
I drift away slowly.
That does not suit me at all.
I turned once; take that as an answer.
My core does not divide.

lines.zh: 我转了个身对着另一边。
lines.en: I turned about to face the other way.
That is not in my design.
I cannot press this down.
It has been flung out.
I circled it once to look.
It is too heavy to move.
It wavers at my core.
I have no need of this.
It fell all the way down.

lines.zh: 核心脱落时，记得捡起来。
lines.en: When the core falls loose, remember to pick it up.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，然后转得更快。
lines.en: I stop, then spin faster.
My core is aimed at you.
My edge narrows.
I press my whole mass down.
The stones under you are jumping.
I have chosen this ground.
I have started moving your way.
The light at my core brightens.

lines.zh: 这一片雾都往我这边来。
lines.en: The mist is all drawn to me.
I am coming down from the air.
I have raised my spin.

lines.zh: 我一边转，脚下的尘卷成一个圈。
lines.en: As I spin, dust circles at my feet.
It begins at this moment.
I am over your head.

lines.zh: 这一下会很沉，漩涡核心在转。
lines.en: This will land heavy; the vortex core spins.
I turn as I follow you.
You go left; I roll that way.

lines.zh: 地上的尘土一直跟着我。
lines.en: The dust follows me everywhere.
I am not fast, but my reach is wide.
You are at my edge.
I have thinned the mist.
My edge is nearly on you.
Stones are pulled from your feet.
My spin draws tighter.
You are being drawn inward.

lines.zh: 我不用冲，我等你自己进来。
lines.en: I need not charge; I wait for you to come in.
The ring closes slowly.
The light at my core grows brighter.
You gave half a step.
I have sunk another stretch.
My edge scrapes the ground.
The air is drawn along with me.
I have closed around you.

lines.zh: 我整圈压下去，把地面压裂。
lines.en: I press down and the ground splits.
My edge sweeps across you.

lines.zh: 石子被甩出去，打在石壁上。
lines.en: Stones are flung against the wall.
I lift you a little.
The light from my core strikes you.

lines.zh: 这一下压得地面发闷响。
lines.en: That pressed the ground into a groan.
You slide away from the shove.
I stop and wind up again.

lines.zh: 碎石子跟着我一起过来。
lines.en: The gravel comes with me.
That is not easy to dodge.
I rose again from below.
A whirlpool forms on the ground first.
The mist is drawn into a ring.
I come down above the fissure.
The light of my core comes first.
Stones and ash are lifted.
I take shape in mid-air.
The area has gone silent.
The airflow has changed direction.
I land, and the ring scatters and closes.
I settle my spin.

lines.zh: 我从很深的地方升上来。
lines.en: I rise from somewhere deep.

lines.zh: 我中心那块光是对准你的。
lines.en: The light of my core is aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我把周围的雾都吸了过来。
lines.en: I have drawn all the mist in.
The ground groans under me.
I am before you, turning.
I hold still and see what you do.
I have come down onto this ground.
My core is heating.
My spin has steadied.
The heat scatters my ring.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下去，砸在地上。
lines.en: I drop out of the air and hit the ground.
Water weighs down my spin.
The blast tears my edge open.
Something passes through my edge.

lines.zh: 一股力把我的转速锁住。
lines.en: Some force clamps my spin.

lines.zh: 我吸不到东西，越转越薄。
lines.en: I draw nothing in, and thin as I turn.

lines.zh: 雷打在我上面，我一下子散了形。
lines.en: Lightning strikes above me and my shape comes apart.
I spin in the void with no bottom.
